sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A stemless perennial native to tropical Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. It forms a rosette of upright, rigid, narrow leaves up to about 60–65 cm long.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The flower stalk can exceed 75 cm and bears pale flowers. The fruits are globose berries about 7–10 mm in diameter.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is reported by the taxonomic source consulted.
